methods.what:
Period table of the normalized integrals of the first kind $u_
u$ (periods $\pi i$ and $a_{
u,
u'}$)
Symmetry of the period matrix, obtained by integrating $u\,du'$ around the boundary of the dissected surface
methods.quote: Theor. I. $a_{\iota,\iota'} = a_{\iota',\iota}$, denn $\int u_\iota du_{\iota'}$ durch die Begrenzung von $T'$[?] $= 0 = \pi i\, a_{\iota,\iota'} - \pi i\, a_{\iota',\iota}$

methods.what: Definition of the Riemann theta function as an exponential series
Quasi-periodicity of theta: the periods (moduli of periodicity) of $\log\theta$
Counting the zeros of theta by integrating $d\log\theta$ around the boundary
methods.quote: $\int d\log\theta$ durch die Begrenzung von $T_\iota = +2n\pi i$ | $\theta = 0$.

methods.what: Periods of the logarithmic derivative of theta
Relation between the periods $b$ of a function $v$ with a pole and its residues $\gamma$, via the boundary integral
methods.quote: $\int v\, du_\iota$ durch die Begrenzung von $T^*_\iota = 0 = +\gamma_\iota 2\pi i + \pi i\, b_\iota$

methods.what: Normalized combinations $w_\iota$ of the functions $v$, with coefficients defined by a biorthogonality condition
Period relation for an integral of the second kind
methods.quote: $\int v\, du_\iota$ durch die Begrenzung v. $T_\iota$ im pos. Sinne $= \gamma_\iota 2\pi i = t_\iota \pi i$, $t_\iota = 2\gamma_\iota$

methods.what: Periods of the integral $W_\iota$ and the boundary integral of $W_\iota du_\iota$
